No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

In this discussion you examine food ingredients through farming, exchange, ritual and material culture.

It is run as a guided conversation, online or on your campus, and works best with a group that is ready to argue a point.

What it covers

  • Map an ingredient's cultural uses
  • Historical trade and ecological context
  • Compare objects, texts and oral traditions
  • Discussion of uncertainty

How the time is spent

  1. Map an ingredient's cultural uses 15 min

  2. Historical trade and ecological context 25 min

  3. Compare objects, texts and oral traditions 30 min

  4. Discussion of uncertainty 20 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Map the cultural uses of an ingredient across farming, exchange, ritual and material culture.
  • Place ingredients such as coconut and spice in their historical trade and ecological context.
  • Compare objects, texts and oral traditions as evidence, and discuss where uncertainty remains.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
